caption: The drawing depicts an iron window grill set into a brick wall. The composition features a rectangular window framed by layers of brickwork, drawn with linear and crosshatch techniques to suggest texture. The grill itself is composed of looping and swirling black iron bars, including symmetrical spirals and leaf-like ornamentation on either side, as well as larger circular and curving elements that cross at the center. The entire image is rendered in black ink on a light, off-white background. At the bottom, centered below the illustration, the label “IRON WINDOW GRILL” is written in uppercase letters.
title: Iron Work in Attic Window
